chapters.title: Who I am
text: I'm Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu, and I live in Istanbul. I like what sits closest to the machine: processors, embedded systems, the machine's own language.
I'd like to work abroad one day.

chapters.title: Where I study
text: I study Computer Engineering at Yıldız Technical University, YTÜ for short, and I'm in my first year.
Before that came the English prep year. I passed it with AA, full marks.

photos.alt: The university's inner courtyard on a sunny afternoon, trees and a lawn, seen through a tinted lens held close to the camera.
photos.note: The inner courtyard at YTÜ, through a tinted lens.

chapters.title: How I work
text: I work on two tracks. On the first I learn the fundamentals by hand: at school, and through CS50 and similar courses, where I write the code myself.

On the second I build products with AI agents. I direct and optimise multiple agents: I write the specs, make the decisions and review what they build. That track teaches me project discipline and product sense.
Both matter. I don't stay away from AI, and I don't let it stand in for the first track.

chapters.title: At school, by hand
text: School goes on, and it is where most of my hand-written code comes from. Outside class I take CS50, and I write the projects for it myself.
That is all there is on this side for now. More will come, and it will be labelled as work I wrote myself.

chapters.title: The products
text: Three products, all in active development, all built by directing agents.
